title: Tower Defense Heroes
description: Deploy heroic archers, mages, and knights along scenic fantasy trails—upgrade skill trees mid-battle and defend the kingdom gates.
controls: Place hero units on strategic spots along the path and tap upgrades as enemy waves intensify.

zh-CN.title: 塔防英雄
zh-CN.description: 奇幻冒险策略塔防英雄：招募弓箭手、大法师与重甲骑士据守要道，升级英雄技能击退魔物大军保卫王国！
zh-CN.controls: 在道路两侧战略点部署并升级各职业塔防英雄，抵御魔物入侵守卫城堡。
